# Smoke pack source

A short, made-up source for the pack checks. Every name and sentence in it
is invented, and the smoke fixture loads its text from here word for word.

## People

- smoke_one (Smoke One): A test account for the pack loader.
- smoke_two (Smoke Two): A second test account for the pack loader.
- smoke_out (Smoke Out): A third test account, outside every group.

## Groups

### Smoke common room

A test group for the pack loader.

### Smoke back room

A closed test group. Only Smoke One is in it.

## Library

### Smoke page

This page exists to prove that a pack loads from its own directory. We meet again on day +7.

### Smoke shared page

This page is shared with the whole community. The common room may read it.

### Smoke back room page

The back room holds the brass lantern.
